hypothesis.statement: When the 8h funding settlement rate of the BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual falls into the lowest registered decile of its own trailing 180-day mid-rank distribution (crowded short positioning: shorts pay longs), the subsequent 24h is expected to be POSITIVE for a long position.
hypothesis.mechanism: Perpetual funding is a recurring cost of holding a position, so it is a positioning signal. Deeply negative funding means leveraged shorts are crowded and their carry cost is high, which is the condition for short covering / liquidation cascades. The source reports the effect as asymmetric: only the negative tail is informative at the 24h horizon.
hypothesis.direction: LONG-only. No short leg, no short mirroring: the source reports no reliable short signal at 24h and the card forbids adding one (a short leg would be a new hypothesis requiring a new round).
hypothesis.test_statistic: The single registered cohort (BTCUSDT/15m): the deterministic historical-only winner cell is carried unchanged into OOS, the full window, eleven registered phase grids and its historical parameter neighbourhood. The family statistic is the COUNT of cohort survivors (0 or 1 here), never a cross-cohort median.
hypothesis.source: Memon, Anklesaria-Dalal & Mishra (2026), AIJMR 4(4), DOI 10.62127/aijmr.2026.v04i04.1493 (working-paper-tier journal; treated as such).

signal_domain.percentile_definition: mid-rank percentile of the current funding rate within its own trailing window: rank = (observations STRICTLY below the current value + 0.5) / observations in the window
signal_domain.window_rule: the trailing window is [t - lookback_days, t] and includes the current observation at t; only observations at or before t enter it, so the value can never be a look-ahead
signal_domain.warmup_rule: a percentile exists only once the trailing window is FULLY covered by the loaded funding series (t - lookback >= the first observation of that series); before that the signal is undefined and can never trigger an entry
signal_domain.entry_timing: the settlement is observable AT t; the entry fills on the close of the bar that STARTS at t (the next executable price, one bar lagged, no look-ahead). The structure is asserted at run time (entry_never_before_signal)
signal_domain.holding: time exit 24h after the settlement that created the position: the position is reduce-only flattened on the close of the bar that ends exactly at T + 24h, after which the book is FLAT until the next qualifying signal
signal_domain.overlap_handling: NON-overlapping primary protocol: a settlement that fires while a position is open is skipped. The overlapping variant is reported as a non-gating diagnostic only and is never mixed into the primary
signal_domain.no_extra_exits: no signal-level stop-loss, take profit or trailing stop is added (the source specifies none): the only exits are the registered DCA rail's breakeven-anchored TP, its resting invalidation, the 24h time exit and the inherited capital-exhaustion backstop

dca_execution_semantics.authorization: Inherited verbatim from the Strategy A/B engine family (the ladder geometry, breakeven-anchored TP and resting invalidation semantics); this round parametrises the four axes and bounds the rail by the 24h signal window - it does not re-interpret the execution semantics.
dca_execution_semantics.trigger_anchoring: the LADDER is anchored on the INITIAL ENTRY FILL PRICE of the episode
dca_execution_semantics.invalidation_anchoring: the resting invalidation is anchored on the running AVERAGE COST, the same reference as the breakeven-anchored TP
dca_execution_semantics.window_bounded: tranche #1 is the initial entry after the settlement; adverse-price scale-ins follow the ladder inside the window (level_k price = initial_entry_price x (1 - spacing_pct x k), k = 1..10, so at most 11 routine active levels of the 12-tranche rail); the 24h time exit reduce-only flattens every layer, then the book is FLAT and no layer may be added again before the next qualifying signal

engine_semantics.entry: the close of the bar that starts at the settlement (one bar lagged), taker fill with adverse slippage
engine_semantics.sizing: non-compounding fixed-quote basis on the pre-registered starting equity: level k margin = base_quote x size_multiplier^k (k = 0..10); level notional = margin x leverage
engine_semantics.take_profit: reduce-only full flatten of the whole episode when the bar high >= running_average_cost x (1 + breakeven_tp_pct)
engine_semantics.invalidation: a RESTING stop at running_average_cost x (1 - invalidation_pct), anchored on the same reference as the take profit
engine_semantics.intrabar_ordering: Descending-price trigger walk with the bar LOW reached first, then the bar HIGH. Walking down from the bar open, the next trigger is whichever of the next ladder level and the resting stop is HIGHER; ladder levels below the resting stop are never reachable. The stop fills at min(stop price, bar open) - a gap through the stop cannot fill at the stop price. Deterministic and never flattering.
engine_semantics.capital_exhaustion: backstop only: forced full flatten at the bar close if unrealised equity <= margin_maint x notional; evaluated after the down-walk and after the resting stop
engine_semantics.concurrency: one position episode at a time; no new entry while a position is open (non-overlapping protocol); no pyramiding beyond the ladder; no short side; no add after FLAT/kill

selector_and_disposition.selection_protocol: Deterministic, historical window ONLY; OOS must never be used to select parameters.
selection_steps: 1. Sufficiency: if the cohort's best historical case has fewer episodes than gates.min_episodes_is, the cohort is culled with reason insufficient_trades.
2. Eligibility: a case is a candidate iff historical net_pnl > 0 AND historical sharpe > 0 AND historical episodes >= gates.min_episodes_is.
3. If no case is a candidate, the cohort is culled with reason no_qualifying_candidate.

4. Ranking: Sharpe descending, then net_pnl descending, then a fixed lexical tie-break over the REGISTERED INDEX of each axis in the fixed order (decile, lookback_days, spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct). The first case is the cohort winner.

5. The winner's exact strategy+DCA cell is carried unchanged into OOS, full, every robustness grid, the official-only provenance rerun and the neighbourhood test. No cell may be swapped after OOS has been seen.
cohort_survivor_requirements: b) OOS: net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 for the winner's cell
c) full window: net_pnl > 0 for the winner's cell
d) robustness: the SAME winner cell has net_pnl > 0 in each of fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks

e) parameter neighbourhood: at least 60% of the winner cell's legal face-adjacent neighbours (one +-1 step on exactly one registered axis, in-domain) agree with the winner's historical net-PnL sign. The neighbourhood judgement uses HISTORICAL rows only - never OOS.

costs.apply_rule: every fill is a market order: taker fee on the full traded notional, plus adverse slippage of baseline_slippage_ticks instrument ticks (1 tick = price_increment). No maker fills are assumed anywhere.

The no_funding / no_funding_full grids re-measure the same cells with the funding cost zeroed (descriptive), and funding_2x doubles it.

metrics_definitions.equity: 30000 + cumulative realised net PnL (USDT); unrealised marked at bar closes
metrics_definitions.daily_series: end-of-UTC-day equity marks, forward-filled across flat stretches
metrics_definitions.sharpe: mean/std (ddof=1) of daily returns x sqrt(365); risk-free 0
metrics_definitions.max_dd: peak-to-trough of the daily equity series, reported in % and USDT
metrics_definitions.cagr: (ending_equity / 30000) ^ (1/years) - 1, years from the actual bar span
metrics_definitions.max_effective_leverage: max of (position notional / unrealised equity), sampled every in-market bar
metrics_definitions.capital_utilization: mean of (deployed margin / unrealised equity) over in-market bars
metrics_definitions.turnover: sum of |fill notional| over every entry / DCA add / exit fill of the cell
metrics_definitions.dca_layer_histogram: count of fills per ladder level, aggregated over all full-window base cases (144 cells); direct evidence of how much of the 12-tranche rail is reachable under resting-stop sequencing
metrics_definitions.cohort_winner: the historical-only selector output for the BTCUSDT/15m cohort

items.name: execution stress reruns
items.method: full-window evaluation of all registered cells under fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks; the winner's cell must stay net_pnl > 0 in all four

items.name: funding baseline diagnostics
items.method: no_funding (historical window) and no_funding_full (full window) grids for all cells; descriptive only, never a gate

items.name: cost attrition (G8)
items.method: cost_attrition_40bps grid for all cells; the winner's cell must stay net_pnl > 0, otherwise the cohort is culled with reason robustness_economic:cost_attrition_40bps

items.name: official-only provenance rerun
items.method: the same protocol re-run on the official-funding era (>= 2023-11-01); family-level provenance check; never PASS on a mismatch

items.name: decile sensitivity (threshold instability)
items.method: the 5th/10th/20th percentile tracks at the winner's remaining parameters on the OOS window; a sign disagreement is disclosed and can never be PASS

items.name: per-year and per-settlement-phase stability

gates.G1_coverage: every one of the 11 registered phase grids must contain exactly 144 cases (1 cohort x 3 strategy cases x 48 DCA configs), the measured strategy/DCA cell sets must equal the registered cartesian products, and the case evaluation total must equal 1,584; otherwise TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE and no cohort is judged
gates.G2_insufficient_trades: per cohort only: fewer than min_episodes_is historical episodes in the cohort's best case culls the cohort (insufficient_trades)
gates.G3_cohort_selector: historical net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 AND episodes >= min_episodes_is, ranked by Sharpe desc, net_pnl desc, registered-index lexical tie-break
gates.G4_cohort_oos: the registered OOS economic gate is STRICTER than the contract minimum: OOS net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 AND annualized Sharpe >= min_oos_sharpe (0.40) AND annualized return >= min_oos_annualized_return (0.0)
gates.G5_cohort_full: full-window net_pnl > 0 for the winner's cell
gates.G6_cohort_robustness: the winner's cell has net_pnl > 0 in all four execution stress reruns
gates.G7_cohort_neighbourhood: at least 60% of legal face-adjacent neighbours agree in historical net-PnL sign
gates.G8_cohort_cost_attrition: the winner's cell has net_pnl > 0 in the cost_attrition_40bps grid
gates.verdict_rule: TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE if G1 fails; else the cohort passing G3-G8 is a SURVIVOR: 0 survivors -> REJECT, 1 survivor -> PASS (band SURVIVOR_FOUND). The two registered family-level falsification items then forbid PASS (see registered_family_level_falsification). No post-hoc threshold edits, no tuning to pass.
gates.min_episodes_is_provenance: the source's no-signal / failure threshold is expressed as an OOS mean-return criterion, not an episode count; the project's already-registered no-signal floor for a historical-selection window is 20 episodes (Strategy A v2 / B v2). 20 is adopted verbatim here - it is not lowered and it is disclosed as the project precedent rather than presented as a source-specified number.
gates.known_gate_set_limitation: The registered gate set contains no benchmark-relative test. A long-only strategy can show positive PnL purely through the sample's upward drift. This limitation is declared BEFORE the run and is NOT patched afterwards; a buy-and-hold comparison remains a non-gating diagnostic.

falsification: no signal / insufficient trades (G2; culls the cohort)
OOS economic rejection of the winner cell (G4: annualized Sharpe < 0.40 or annualized return < 0)
full-window economic rejection of the winner cell (G5)
robustness economic failure of the winner cell (G6)
parameter-neighbourhood fragility of the winner cell (G7)
cost attrition: the winner cell turns negative under 40 bps per fill (G8)
funding-provenance rejection (primary vs official_only sign mismatch or > 50% difference) -> TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE / DEFERRED, never PASS
threshold instability (5th/10th/20th percentile tracks disagree in OOS sign) -> descriptive disclosure, never PASS
DCA execution incomplete or not true order-fill accounting (see assertions.json; any false assertion = TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE)
coverage incomplete in any registered phase grid (G1)
performance_claimable_rule: true only when the family verdict == PASS (>=1 cohort survivor) and contract 9.6 holds (canonical raw, no look-ahead, explicit OOS, declared costs, full section 7.2 coverage including the DCA parameter domain) and neither registered family-level falsification item has fired. The number of survivors is never itself a reason to claim false.
